name: Orange peel fungus patch 002
glow_concept: single glowing raindrop pooled in every cup
prompt: a cluster of small goblet-shaped cup fungi growing from mossy ground, orange peel fungus patch, tiny, ankle-height to an adult person, self-emissive at night, softly radiating light: single glowing raindrop pooled in every cup

placement.note: Render the sprite scaled so its height == world_px_height; a character is character_height_px tall.

motion.description: This is an almost completely still picture. ONLY the outermost edge of the gold centres of the cup fungi changes, and barely: a few pixels along that edge lift very slightly in brightness and drop straight back. The gold centres of the cup fungi is fully visible and exactly as easy to read in every frame -- it never fades, never vanishes and is never swallowed by glare. Its inside stays exactly the gold it is in the first frame. Nothing is added or removed anywhere, and nothing changes size. Everything else is copied from the first frame exactly, pixel for pixel: same shape, size, position and colour. The last frame matches the first exactly.
